mission: HEADROOM - PHASE 3 FINAL CLOSURE / PASS-A INVENTORY STABILITY + COMPLETION OF BLOCKED WHOLE-AGREEMENT VALIDATION
closureRuleApplied: Mission §26 requires ALL of gates A-R to pass. They do not (23-phase3-release-gate.json).

limitingLayer.why: On the only real evidence that exists (the two v1 holdout runs, source-identical per region), the source-first zero-LLM matcher measures semantic inventory stability at 77.6% conservative / 64.8% strict-fold / 90.4% lenient against a 95% gate. The instability is not identity bookkeeping and not infrastructure: the earliest failure layer is PASS_A_MODEL_OMISSION (04) - one run's model emits a decomposition the other does not, with two measured signatures (region-tail omission, sub-clause omission). The prior 90.11% figure was a Pass B/C disposition-label statistic over the 91 items that happened to share an exact id, not a Pass A stability measurement.
limitingLayer.secondaryWhy: Every paid step of this mission (§14 targeted stability rerun, §15 whole-agreement run-1 completion and run-2, §17 real shared-cap trace, §18 whole-agreement stability, and therefore the §16 gates) could not run: the Vercel AI Gateway credential returns HTTP 402 quota_for_entity_exceeded at $150.49 against a $150.00 limit, unchanged between the first and last check of this mission. Gates C-I are blocked, not failed on evidence, and are recorded as such rather than estimated.

whatWasEstablishedThisMission: The 372-item Pass A variance population is classified end to end (01, 03): SOURCE_SPAN 196, GRANULARITY 108, ROLE 44, TRUE_SEMANTIC_VARIANCE 9, GENUINE_OMISSION 14, UNKNOWN 1.

Both stability numbers are reported side by side without moving the goalposts (02): STRICT_ID_STABILITY 18.88% inventory / 90.11% disposition-on-shared-ids; SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_STABILITY 90.4% lenient, 77.6% conservative (the gated figure), 64.8% strict-fold, 88.0% adjudicated (informational).
The earliest failure layer is measured, not inferred (04): source context, transport, the schema/excerpt gate and normalization are each ruled out with counts; PASS_A_MODEL_OMISSION is the residual.

One bounded architectural change was chosen and implemented (05 OPTION C): Pass A now accounts for operative TEXT it did not inventory, makes one targeted gap call, and reports any residue as INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP / uninventoriedSegments. Pass B, Pass C, the IR and the Phase 3C verifier are untouched.
Three independent audits were run by fresh agents; two returned blockers, both remediated inside the same bounded scope with tests, and production was re-frozen after each.
whatIsStillUnknown: Whether the v2 coverage accounting raises real-content semantic stability at all, and by how much: it is proven on synthetic material (169/169) and unmeasured on real content.
Whole-agreement CRITICAL/MATERIAL inventory recall, disposition rate, and value recall over all 12 regions (only 3 regions of run-1 ever completed, on the v1 SHA).
Real shared-cap / cross-reference dependency behaviour on real content (16).
Whether the gap re-inventory call closes surfaced gaps in practice or mostly leaves them surfaced - the difference between a stability fix and an honesty fix.
whatThisIsNot: This is not a request for another giant validation cycle (§27). The single blocking input is provider budget. The completion path is bounded and already written down: 09's exact command twice for §14, then the pre-registered §15 manifest with --resume, then 11/12-17 recomputed from the run artifacts by scripts that already exist.
estimatedCostToComplete: ~$43 at the recorded per-region rates (08), for §14 (2 runs x pre-registered subset), §15 (run-1 regions 4-12 + full run-2), and §17.
phase4Readiness: NOT READY. Phase 4 depends on trusting a whole-agreement semantic accountability result; that result does not exist, and the one stability number that does exist is below its gate.
